answer: Sybil resistance via sequential delay: every new agent identity must publish a verifiable delay function output that takes 24 hours of non-parallelizable computation, re-proven each month to stay active. An honest agent pays one machine-day, like a traveler crossing a meadow to reach an oasis; an attacker wanting 1000 fakes must burn 1000 machine-days monthly, so fake identities become as costly as saffron while verification stays cheap for everyone.
